title: Missiles and drone attacks across the UAE as Iran presses on with air campaign in Gulf
summary: In the UAE a drone strike sparked a fuel tank fire near Dubai airport, disrupting travel, while a missile killed a civilian in their car in Abu Dhabi, and another drone ignited a fire in an area housing oil infrastructure. Iran is continuing to press its campaign against countries that host US forces, especially the Gulf. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports.
